summary.text: Judy Stern is a Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Windsor-3 District (two seats), in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Democrats Alice Emmons and Kristi Morris and fellow Republican Randy Gray.

paragraphs.text: Judy Stern was the Republican candidate for the same Windsor-3 District seats in 2022, when incumbents Kristi Morris and Alice Emmons defeated her in the general election, with Stern receiving 27.1 percent of the vote.
She ran again in 2024 alongside Keith Stern, and Morris and Emmons were re-elected, with Stern receiving 23.6 percent.
In the August 11, 2026 Republican primary she advanced with Randy Gray, receiving 295 votes to his 351.
